page: Microsoft Azure M128bds_v3 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8473C processor operating at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz, featuring 64 physical cores and 128 virtual CPUs via Hyper-Threading. The hardware configuration includes 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Local storage is limited to a 410 GB disk, though the system is premium storage capable and optimized for block storage performance. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in memory bandwidth, with read-only small block cached memory bandwidth and large block uncached read/write operations all placing in the top 10% tier. Multi-threaded processing is highly efficient, as demonstrated by top-tier results in bzip3 multi-threaded decompression, passmark CPU score, and passmark CPU encryption tests. Single-core performance is moderate, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance and bzip3 single-threaded decompression scoring in the average tier. Database operations and Redis SET operations both achieved top-tier status, processing 138.18 million operations per second in Redis.

The server exhibits high resource density with its 1 TB memory capacity and 128 vCPUs, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for large-scale memory-bound workloads that do not require GPU acceleration. However, the relatively small 410 GB local storage capacity represents a tradeoff, requiring external premium block storage for data-heavy applications. The system is suited for memory-intensive databases, large-scale Redis deployments, multi-threaded data processing, and high-throughput static web serving.
